_comment: Our own tests for requirements of the profile. These are not OWASP tests and are scored apart from them. See README.md.

tests.title: No code is loaded at run time in the Android code
tests.description: The Android code of the app and its own plugins does not load code at run time. Libraries are not covered.

checks.title: A finding is a class loader or System.load call in our Android code.

tests.title: Clipboard writes in the Dart code
tests.description: Lists every place where the Dart code writes to the clipboard, so that each one is a recorded decision.

checks.title: A finding is a write to the clipboard; a person checks what is copied.

tests.title: Error reports carry no default personal data
tests.description: Error reporting never switches on the default personal data of Sentry, and the setting that turns it off is in place.

checks.title: A finding is sendDefaultPii switched on.

tests.title: Release builds obfuscate the Dart code
tests.description: The fastlane release builds for Android and iOS pass the obfuscation flags. The F-Droid app is not built through fastlane and is not covered.

checks.title: Looks for --obfuscate with --split-debug-info in the Fastfile.

tests.title: JavaScript channels exposed to WebViews in the Dart code
tests.description: Lists every JavaScript channel the Dart code gives to a WebView, so that each one is a recorded decision.

checks.title: A finding is a JavaScript channel given to a WebView; a person checks what it exposes.

tests.title: Detection of dynamic analysis tools is in the code
tests.description: The Android and iOS plugins still look for instrumentation tools such as Frida. This shows that the measure is in the code; how it behaves is covered by the unit tests in yivi_core/test/app_integrity_test.dart.

checks.title: Looks for the Frida markers in the Android integrity plugin.
Looks for the Frida markers in the iOS integrity plugin.

tests.title: Detection of app-cloning containers is in the code
tests.description: The Android plugin still checks that the app runs from its own data directory. This shows that the measure is in the code; how it behaves is covered by the Android unit test AppIntegrityPluginTest.kt.

checks.title: Looks for the data directory check in the Android integrity plugin.

tests.title: The privacy policy is linked before enrollment
tests.description: The terms screen of the enrollment still links the privacy policy.

checks.title: Looks for the privacy policy link on the terms screen.
